pamphlet_excerpts: Pre-Participation Physical & Health Check: Calcium is found in dairy products such as milk, cheese, and yogurt, and foods such as nuts, beans, broccoli, and canned salmon (p. 7).
Pre-Participation Physical & Health Check Principle 2: Making sure you have at least four servings of calcium daily will help ensure that your bones stay strong throughout your life (p. 7).

Pre-Participation Physical & Health Check Principle 3: If you do not get enough calcium in your diet while you are young, you could be at risk for the bone-thinning disease called osteoporosis (p. 7).
Pre-Participation Physical & Health Check Principle 4: Failing to fuel and refuel your body with good foods can lead to fatigue and injury; you will also be more likely to getsick (p. 7).
step_by_step_procedure: Step 1 (Pre-Participation Physical & Health Check): Develop good eating habits now so that they will become second nature to you throughout your lifetime (p. 7).
Step 2 (Pre-Participation Physical & Health Check): For more information about nutrition and physical fitness, read the Cooking and Personal Fitness merit badge pamphlets (p. 7).
Step 3 (Pre-Participation Physical & Health Check): To be a strong, healthy performer in athletics and in life, avoid tobacco, alcohol, and other harmful substances (p. 7).
Step 4 (Pre-Participation Physical & Health Check): Smoking makes you cough and wheeze, and it interferes with proper lung growth and lung function (p. 7).
